summary: Preserve runtime evaluation for computed numeric enum initializer.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: call initializer
tests.input: function f(){return 9}; enum E { A=f() }; console.log(E.A,E[9]);

tests.name: ordering
tests.input: let a=[] as number[];const f=(x:number)=>(a.push(x),x); enum E { A=f(1),B=f(2) }; console.log(a.join(','));
